name: Waildworld

sources.title: Homepage — live AI-tools directory (3,359 tools, 30 categories, EN/DE/RU) with embedded 'Submit a tool' form and rules

requirements: AI tools only — directory covers 30 categories from 3D to Writing
Check the tool is not already listed before submitting ('ensure that it hasn't been already listed')
No affiliate links and no newsletter submissions
Tool aggregators are only considered with a reciprocal listing that includes wAild world
Manual review of every submission ('Our team reviews each submission manually')
preparation: Category tags from the fixed list (3D, Art, Audio, Business, Chatbots, Code, Crypto, Design, Education, Finance, Food, Fun, Gaming, Kids, Healthcare, HR, Legal, Lifestyle, Marketing, Photo, Productivity, Sales, Security, Sport, Speech, Translation, Travel, Video, Writing)
Pricing model pick: Free / Paid / Free Trial / Freemium / Price by request / Not launched yet
Personal/contact information for the 'Personal Information' block
workflow: Open https://waildworld.com/ and scroll to the 'Submit a tool' section (also linked in the header)
Search the catalog first to confirm the tool is not already listed
Fill Tool Information, select product tags, and pick the pricing model
Complete Personal Information and click Submit (agrees to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy)
Wait for manual review; for collaboration or tool/job submissions the footer also lists submit@waildworld.com
watchFor: Reciprocal-link requirement if the submission is itself a tool aggregator/directory
Strict anti-cheat: bot or fraudulent upvoting leads to immediate disqualification
Footer contact split: hi@waildworld.com for collaboration, submit@waildworld.com for tool/job submissions
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the waildworld.com catalog under its chosen tags and is reachable via category/search pages
unknowns: Whether the form requires an account — a login exists for favourites but the submit form's auth needs were not visible in rendered text
Exact fields inside 'Personal Information' (email vs name) — inputs did not render labels
